Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - redis-cache-prod connections spiking (service: redis-cache-prod, alert: redis.maxclients). Pager: page fired to oncall-sre
PagerDuty Bot: Incident triggered: redis-cache-prod - maxclients reached - escalation policy: db-cache-team
Alice L: ack
Alice L: seeing errors in the metrics dashboard - 90th p99 connection wait time > 120ms and new connections failing
Bob M: logs show repeated 'ERR max number of clients reached' from primary redis instance
Carlos G: is this single-node primary or a cluster? which AZ?
Alice L: primary in us-west-2a, replica us-west-2b. primary maxclients currently 10000 (we set that a month ago)
Erin (DBA): bringing up `INFO clients` now
Erin (DBA): ```
# INFO clients
connected_clients:9987
blocked_clients:23
``` 
Erin (DBA): `CONFIG GET maxclients` -> `10000`
Bob M: connection churn looks high — lots of short lived clients, spiking due to a recent deploy? Traffic graph shows a small jump in connection attempts at 18:12 UTC
Alice L: can we enable client-eviction by proxy? I want to avoid dropping requests in prod
Carlos G: small mitigation: temporarily bump `maxclients` by 2k and trigger an orchestrated restart of the least-used replica to shed idle connections. but need to coordinate with infra
Alice L: what's the POD/instance type? risk of OOM?
Erin (DBA): instance is r5.large equivalent. current memory usage 68% - bumping maxclients is safe for a short window but won't fix the root cause
Bob M: I'm going to add a temporary rate-limit on the create-connection path in the internal SDK gateway for 60s
Alice L: good — apply the rate-limit and keep it modest: 50 req/s per region
Oncall Handoff: @Carlos G you're next up in 8 minutes; if this is still active please take the pager
Incident Bot: :pager: PagerDuty: ack by Alice L at 18:20:15 UTC
Alice L: alerting customers? which teams impacted
Carlos G: backend-embedder and realtime-chat call redis frequently; we are seeing elevated errors on both. SLO risk for realtime-chat (error rate from 0.2% -> 3%)
Bob M: mitigation timeline: apply SDK rate-limit (5m), bump maxclients to 12000 (1m), schedule replica restart (5m), monitor for connection dropoff
Alice L: run commands for bump — Erin, can you patch Redis config via redis-cli? We'll throttle after
Erin (DBA): running `CONFIG SET maxclients 12000` now
Erin (DBA): ```
OK
``` 
Erin (DBA): monitoring for rejected connections
Bob M: rate-limit applied to SDK gateway - rule id rtk-conn-throttle-1805
Alice L: seeing a drop in `ERR max number of clients` logs already
Carlos G: traffic still churny but reclaimed headroom. p99 connection wait down to 35ms
Oncall Handoff: handing off to Carlos G — taking over the pager now. @Alice L can you add runbook context in thread?
Alice L: added runbook excerpt: "If redis maxclients reached: 1) check INFO clients and blocked_clients, 2) apply SDK rate-limit on connector, 3) CONFIG SET maxclients <temp>, 4) plan replica restart to clear stale connections, 5) open INC ticket for RCA"
Carlos G: I'm going to coordinate replica restart at 18:28 UTC. will drain and restart replica us-west-2b
Bob M: plan: restart replica, ensure replication sync, then observe primary for 15m. If issues persist escalate to infra for capacity increase or move to a bigger instance
Incident Bot: PagerDuty: escalation policy evaluated — no further escalation required (ack by Alice L)
Erin (DBA): replica restart initiated
Erin (DBA): `systemctl restart redis` on replica returned OK
Erin (DBA): replication offset catching up, replica in sync
Carlos G: no customer-facing incidents opened yet, but we've notified SRE lead and support. creating INC-INC1805 in our tracker for follow-up
Alice L: add post-incident actions: investigate client churn pattern, check for SDK bug that opens many short-lived connections, consider adding connection pooling or pgbouncer in front of redis for high-churn workloads
Bob M: monitoring looks stable now — error rate for realtime-chat back to 0.3% and redis rejected connections at 0
Carlos G: I'm leaving the pager to do a 30m observation window. If everything stays green I'll close the incident and hand back to normal ops
Oncall Handoff: noted — handover recorded. next oncall: @Oncall Handoff
Carlos G: closing thread in 30m if stable. create a follow-up ticket for capacity plan
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved summary: temporary `maxclients` bump and SDK rate-limit + replica restart. follow-up: INC-1805 assigned to DBA Erin and SRE Bob for RCA
Alice L: thanks everyone — great coordination :thumbsup:
